policy: HFT-008: keep public _unchecked only when ALL four pre-registered conditions hold on ≥1 production caller shape: (1) optimized instruction/assembly evidence of removed validation, (2) ≥8/10 isolated process runs favour unchecked with aggregate 95% CI of latency ratio wholly on the unchecked side of 1.0, (3) median latency improvement ≥2% after harness overhead, (4) no paired e2e p99/p99.9 regression >2%. Failed candidates stay module-private.

profiles: debug cargo test Instant multi-run (supporting only — not a keep proof)
release cargo run --release Instant multi-run (10 isolated processes)
measured.instruction_tooling: iai-callgrind removed (RUSTSEC-2026-0173 via proc-macro-error2). No Valgrind/callgrind instruction matrix on this host. Release Instant multi-run is the keep-latency evidence; instruction/assembly keep gate therefore cannot pass.

wrap_and_apply_header/exact_ctor.note: LLVM effectively elides the cold bounds check on exact stack buffers; twin adds no measurable win.

decode/*.note: Noisy Instant ratios; CI not wholly on unchecked side; no instruction proof of removed bounds work (decode_unchecked still does protocol header validation).

AnyMessage::decode/exact_dispatch.note: Median improvement >2% but 95% CI for ratio includes values ≤1.0; instruction proof missing.

candidates.name: wrap_unchecked
candidates.reason: Release multi-run fails favour≥8 and ≥2% median; often slower than checked. No instruction proof.

candidates.name: wrap_and_apply_header_unchecked
candidates.reason: Release exact_ctor median improvement ~0.3%; ratio≈1.00 (check elided). Opaque fails favour≥8. No instruction proof of retained twin value.

candidates.name: decode_unchecked
candidates.reason: Release CI not wholly on unchecked side; still validates protocol header fields; no instruction proof of removed memory bounds work.

candidates.name: AnyMessage::decode_unchecked
candidates.reason: Latency median promising but 95% CI crosses 1.0; no optimized instruction/assembly proof. Remain private.

candidates.name: AnyMessage::decode_frame_unchecked
candidates.reason: No public twin emitted; complete-frame trusted cursor deferred.

codegen_consequence: Generated zero-check cores are module-private `unsafe fn *_unchecked` (not `pub`). Checked constructors call the private core after one cold extent check. Re-publish only after a future keep=true decision revises this manifest.
